name: @shoplflow/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server exposing the shoplflow design system (tokens, components, icons) to AI coding agents.

ensure:changeset is what republishes mcp when base/assets release — changesets will not.
The root `version` script MUST run it before `changeset version`. Verified by `check:wiring`.
//devDependencies: DO NOT REMOVE the three @shoplflow/* workspace deps below just because nothing imports them.
They are not runtime deps — turbo reads them to order `build:package` after base/assets
have built, so the extractors see the current icon barrels.
They do NOT make changesets bump mcp: a devDependency-only dependent resolves to `none`,
even with updateInternalDependents: always. The base -> mcp republish is done by
Removing them breaks NOTHING visibly: extraction still works (scripts read ../../base/src
by relative path) and the build still passes, but mcp may bundle stale icon metadata.
Guarded by `pnpm check:wiring`. See 아키텍쳐.md section 6.
